label: DisasterReady India - Relief Dispatch & Allocation Engine
title: DisasterReady India - Relief Dispatch & Allocation Engine
prompt:
DisasterReady India Staff Emergency Operations Portal & Deterministic Allocation Engine (Desktop-first Dashboard).
Key elements:
1. Staff Navigation Header & Rail: Officer profile ("Anita Rao, Relief coordinator, Nadipur District"), Stage 1 Overview, Stage 2 Prioritise, Stage 3 Plan, Stage 4 Outcome, Stage 5 Simulate (The Twist), plus Hazard queue and Audit log.
2. Stage 1 Overview (D1):
- Top KPI metric blocks: Total Requests (8), People Affected (1,610), Warehouse Stock Units (2,800 Water, 1,700 Food, 140 Med, 800 Blankets), Critical Deficit (360 Water).
- Split layout: Left SVG Operations Map with warehouse hubs W1, W2, W3 and location delivery routes with truck/tractor/boat access badges; Right Location Table (Mohanpur, Bhadrapur, Pahadi Tola, Sonpur Ghat, Chandpur char, Tilakwada, Kharadi Ward 4, Lakshmipur).
3. Stage 2 Priority Engine (D2):
- Dynamic weights wU (45%), wP (25%), wV (30%) with aging boost switch (+5 pts for >48h waiting).
- Priority Ranking Table matching exact specification: 1 Mohanpur (94.6), 2 Bhadrapur (86.2), 3 Pahadi Tola (85.7), 4 Sonpur Ghat (73.6), 5 Chandpur char (72.4), 6 Tilakwada (63.3), 7 Kharadi Ward 4 (53.0), 8 Lakshmipur (42.3).
- Plain-language factor breakdown modal/expandable ("Urgency +42.8, People +21.7, Vulnerable +27.0, Aging +3.1 = 94.6").
- Manual rank override with required audit reason and re-verification OTP modal (123456).
- Fairness Check warning for Lakshmipur & Kharadi Ward 4 served last in 2 plans.
4. Stage 3 Allocation & Stage 5 Twist Simulation Engine (D3, D5):
- Baseline run: 2,800/3,160 Water delivered (360 short), 140/150 Med (10 short), 1,573/1,610 Food (37 short at Chandpur char due to Boat 200 capacity), 720/760 Blankets (40 short).
- Interactive Simulation Panel: "Block Route 4 (Rani Bridge Sonpur)".
- Live calculation: Diverts W2-L2 and W2-L3 to North road (+35 mins), tractor-trolley constraint (500 unit cap). Side-by-side Before & After comparison table, delta stats, and one-click Undo Simulation.
5. Delivery Verification & Courier Proof Modal: Input 4-digit citizen OTP to record delivery. Two-step staff verification & session timeout dialog (60s demo mode).
